description: This course explores advanced AI applications through hands-on implementation of machine learning algorithms like Naive Bayes, Decision Trees, and Support Vector Machines; natural language processing techniques including sentiment analysis and topic modeling using Python's NLTK and spaCy libraries; and computer vision applications using OpenCV and TensorFlow for image classification and object detection. Students will also study AI ethics frameworks, data privacy standards like GDPR, and the deployment of AI models using Docker and Kubernetes. Topics include reinforcement learning with Q-learning, neural networks for time series forecasting, and AI integration with IoT systems through MQTT protocols.

clos.text: Define key AI application domains such as natural language processing, computer vision, and robotics using industry-specific terminology.
Describe the architecture of machine learning models including data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation metrics like precision and recall.
Explain the principles of deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch, including their implementation for convolutional and recurrent neural networks.
Apply AI techniques to real-world problems by developing a sentiment analysis system using spaCy and deploying it with Docker.
Evaluate the ethical implications of AI deployment, including bias mitigation strategies and compliance with GDPR data protection regulations.

labs: Implement a sentiment analysis model using Naive Bayes
Create a topic model using Gensim
Build a CNN model for image classification using TensorFlow
Develop a Q-learning agent for a simple environment

Present and defend final AI application project
